title: How Much Should an Agent Remember? Deployment Lessons from Self-Distilled Memory for LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.26361v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM agents on long-horizon tasks fail in recurring, procedural ways. They mis-paginate an API, resolve the wrong entity, or answer when no answer was asked. We built a pipeline that lets an agent learn from its own history. It first mines short \emph{lessons} from the agent's own trajectories, one to three per episode. It then consolidates those lessons into a smaller set of \emph{guidelines}, where each guideline records how many lessons it merged. At inference the agent receives either all guidelines or a selected subset. The pipeline ships in the open-source altk-evolve library and is deployed in IBM's CUGA agent and watsonx Orchestrate platform. We report what we learned building, measuring, and productizing it. Our primary instrument is the AppWorld benchmark, across models spanning 40--92\% baseline task completion. translated_title: 智能体应该记住多少？来自LLM智能体自蒸馏记忆的部署经验教训
translated_abstract: LLM智能体在长周期任务中会以反复出现的、程序化的方式失败：它们可能错误地对API进行分页调用、解析到错误的实体，或者在没有被要求作答时给出回答。我们构建了一个让智能体从自身历史中学习的流水线：它首先从智能体自身的轨迹中挖掘简短的“经验教训”，每个回合提取一到三条；然后将这些经验教训整合为一个更小的“指导原则”集合，每条指导原则会记录它合并了多少条经验教训。在推理阶段，智能体接收全部指导原则或经过筛选的子集。该流水线已随开源的altk-evolve库发布，并部署在IBM的CUGA智能体和watsonx Orchestrate平台上。我们报告了在构建、度量和产品化这一流水线过程中所积累的经验。我们的主要评测工具是AppWorld基准，涵盖基线任务完成率在40%至92%之间的多个模型。核心发现是：恰当的记忆量是模型本身的属性，而非记忆机制本身的属性。强模型……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一个让LLM智能体从自身轨迹中自蒸馏“经验教训”并整合为“指导原则”的记忆流水线，已部署于IBM生产环境，核心发现是最佳记忆量取决于模型自身能力而非记忆机制本身。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a self-distilled memory pipeline that mines lessons from an agent's own trajectories and consolidates them into guidelines, deployed in IBM's production agents, with the central finding that the right amount of memory is a property of the model, not the memory system itself.
